summary: Ghar.com v1.2 additions PASS end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_v12_new_features.py covering reviews (list/create/auth/rating-range/upsert-not-duplicate), bridge-calls (POST enriches with caller & owner name/phone, admin list, PUT status validation, buyer 403), admin users (list, role gating), AI price-suggest (structured JSON with per_sqft_min/max + total range + note, auth required), AI check-duplicate (exact seed title -> duplicate:true similarity 1.0; unrelated title -> duplicate:false all matches <0.5). Existing 28/28 pytest cases from iteration_2 remain green. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Admin panel now shows all 5 tabs (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Calls, Users); Users tab lists 12+ users with role (buyer/owner/admin) & verified badges; Calls tab shows the bridge call log entry created via API with caller/owner names+phones and status badge (connected). Owner Add Property flow step 2 renders 'Get AI Price Suggestion' dashed button; tapping it with Mumbai/Andheri/1000 sqft/2BHK returns a suggested range (₹55-85/sqft, ₹55,000-₹85,000) and pre-fills Monthly Rent to 55000. Step 3 has 'Add Photo' tile + Amenities + Description with 'Generate with AI'; tapping Submit for Review without photos correctly shows red error 'Please upload at least 1 photo of your property'. Buyer property detail page shows Reviews & Ratings section with avg + count, 'Write a Review' opens sheet with 5 star pickers + textarea; submitting a 4-star review updates the list in-place and toast 'Thanks for your review!' appears. Tapping Call opens Ghar Connect bridge modal AND a POST to /api/bridge-calls is fired (verified via network capture); the entry is visible in Admin -> Calls tab. Deprecated Expo/RN style warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents) still present (carried from iteration_2) - non-blocking cosmetic.

react_native_issues.issue: Console deprecation still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius -> boxShadow across /app/frontend/app and /app/frontend/src (carried from iteration_2).
Console deprecation still present: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (carried from iteration_2).

action_items: (Non-blocking) Migrate deprecated RN props: shadow* -> boxShadow, pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents across the app.

(Optional hardening) POST /api/bridge-calls currently only requires auth (any role can log a call). If desired, restrict to non-owners of the target property to prevent noise, or add rate-limiting per (user,property).
(Optional UX) After AI Price Suggestion pre-fills the price, consider disabling the button briefly to avoid duplicate LLM calls if a user double-taps.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py review upsert correctly uses {property_id, user_id} composite key with $set on r.model_dump() – count stays 1 for the same user (verified). One subtle detail: r.model_dump() regenerates `id` and `created_at` each call, so the review's id/created_at get replaced on every update. Acceptable but consider using $setOnInsert for id/created_at and $set for rating/comment/updated_at if edit history matters.

server.py /api/ai/check-duplicate performs an exact case-insensitive city match and a regex substring match on locality – be aware locality regex is un-escaped user input; consider re.escape() before injecting to avoid ReDoS or query errors on values like '.*'.

server.py /api/bridge-calls does not require the caller to be authenticated as buyer – owner can also POST a call on their own listing, which will show up in admin panel as pending. Consider blocking self-calls or at least labelling them.
add.tsx price-suggest-btn and submit flow works, but the Submit button remains enabled during network request; consider a spinner state to prevent double submissions.
